🧊 RubiksCube2x2

The 2x2 Rubik's Cube (also called the Pocket Cube) has four small cubes per face instead of nine. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click a face or arrow button to rotate a face of the cube.
  2. Goal: each face shows only one color.
  3. Hold and drag to rotate the entire cube to see all faces.
  4. The 2x2 has fewer pieces — the solution is shorter than a 3x3.
  5. Try the layer-by-layer method: solve one face, then the opposite.
